brief.summary: Equity futures are slightly lower, with Nasdaq down about 1% as Alphabet plunged roughly 10% on AI monetization and free-cash-flow worries; Microsoft’s cloud results were stronger. Treasury yields edged up, the front end by a single basis point and the long end near 5%, while the show described the curve as steeper after the Fed. Credit spreads are slightly wider, the dollar is flat with the euro softer, and oil fell on US-Iran outreach; gold was not discussed. The Fed held hawkishly, with speakers assuming a December hike and criticizing unclear communication. Dominant narratives are AI capex payback, ECB leadership/French election risk, and Iran escalation. Tone is cautious and mixed.
